name: invariant
description: A single numbered normative invariant. Invariants are constraints that conforming implementations must always uphold. The applies_to field (fieldId 1a000021-0000-4000-a000-000000000021) is status: deprecated (RFC-042 Change B/E, srs#559) - superseded by a contains parent relation from the constrained concept; #564 drains the 129 existing values and adds the replacement relation, then removes the field per rfc-decision-5f8204bc (deprecate-then-remove).
